prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic, close-up shot of a computer monitor displaying professional video editing software. The focus is on a vibrant, multicolored waveform and color grading panel, with various adjustment sliders and interface elements visible on the left side of the screen. The image is shot at a dramatic, low angle with a shallow depth of field, creating a sense of immersion and intensity. In the blurred background, the upper portion of a video frame is visible, showing a person in a teal hoodie, but their face is obscured and out of focus. The color palette is dominated by deep blacks and cool blues, punctuated by the vivid neon hues of the waveform—greens, reds, and purples—glowing against the dark interface. The lighting is low and moody, emphasizing the luminous quality of the screen and evoking a late-night, creative atmosphere. The overall style is modern and cinematic, with a sense of motion and energy, as if capturing a moment in the fast-paced world of digital post-production.
